question: # of views of Grand Theft Auto VI Extended Look on week 1?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to the number of views the Grand Theft Auto VI Extended Look video gets in the first 168 hours after being posted on the Rockstar Games YouTube channel. This market may not resolve until the 168 hours are complete, regardless of whether a strike is reached earlier.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

The resolution source for this market is Rockstar Games' YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/@RockstarGames), specifically the 'views' counter for the described video.

Note: This market refers only to "Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look" (see: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tJbzMqJGH4k)

"Other" means any option not listed here.
research:
I couldn't find any YouTube view count for the video dated on or before 2026-08-30, so there is no early trajectory to report. Nearly every count I found was published after the cutoff, so I left those out.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-08-27: The video premiered on Netflix at 3 p.m. ET, exclusive for six hours, then went up on Rockstar's YouTube channel at 9 p.m. ET. That is about 01:00 UTC on Aug 28, so the 168-hour window ends about 01:00 UTC on Sep 4, close to the stated resolution time of 03:04 UTC. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Theft_Auto_VI:_An_Extended_Look)
- I tried to fetch the YouTube page (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tJbzMqJGH4k), but it returned no view count or publish date. [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tJbzMqJGH4k)
- Rockstar's own announcement page also gave no numbers. [Rockstar Newswire](https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/article/4k138k8okkk483/grand-theft-auto-vi-an-extended-look-now-playing)

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-08-30, about three days into the window, I could not find a dated YouTube count from a reliable source. Nothing I found settles the question.
- The answer options skip 30-32M, so a result in that range would count as "Other".

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-29: Stream Charts data, reported by Eurogamer and others, showed reaction streams peaking at about 3.97 million concurrent viewers across roughly 9,000 streamers, with 5.2M hours watched. That beat Summer Game Fest 2026's peak of 3.81M. Some viewers criticized the presentation, comparing it to an expensive GTA V expansion. [PCGames.de](https://www.pcgames.de/GTA-6-Spiel-55239/News/Streaming-Rekord-mit-4-Millionen-Zuschauern-1552403/), [Inven Global](https://labs.invenglobal.com/articles/25362/gta6-tops-netflix-draws-397-million-concurrent-viewers)
- 2026-08-27: Demand crashed Netflix, with about 3,100 user error reports shortly before the premiere, and Twitch had server problems. Many fans watched on Netflix or through co-streams before the YouTube upload, which likely took some views away from YouTube. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Theft_Auto_VI:_An_Extended_Look)
- Format: the video runs about 26-27 minutes, much longer than the earlier trailers. [Red Bull](https://www.redbull.com/int-en/gta-6-extended-look-everything-revealed)

## 4. Base rates
- December 2023: Trailer 1 was YouTube-exclusive. It got about 93M YouTube views in its first day and about 101M within two days. [Sportskeeda](https://www.sportskeeda.com/gta/gta-6-trailer-crosses-100-million-views-youtube-just-day), [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Theft_Auto_VI)
- May 2025: Rockstar said Trailer 2 got 475M views across all platforms in 24 hours. Its YouTube-only count was much lower, and a later snapshot of unknown date put it at about 181M. [TechRadar](https://www.techradar.com/gaming/the-latest-grand-theft-auto-6-trailer-has-set-a-major-record-by-racking-up-475-million-views-in-just-24-hours)
- How this video differs:
  - It went to Netflix first.
  - It is a 27-minute special rather than a roughly 2-minute trailer.
  - It ran on thousands of co-streams.

  These factors probably make the earlier trailers poor anchors for its YouTube views. Long YouTube videos usually get most of their first-week views in the first 48-72 hours, after which daily views fall off sharply. This is a general pattern; I found no source specific to this video.
- Measurement note: YouTube counts any play as a view, while Netflix counts views as hours watched divided by runtime. Numbers from the two platforms can't be compared directly. [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/gta-6-netflix-extended-look-views-1236848409/)

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-08-28: Polymarket opened this market ("# of views of Grand Theft Auto VI Extended Look on week 1?") at 7:04 PM ET. Its end date is Sep 3, 2026. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/of-views-of-grand-theft-auto-vi-extended-look-on-week-1)
- I could not find bracket prices dated on or before Aug 30, and I won't report later snapshots. The forecaster should check the live order book directly.
- I found no Kalshi or Manifold market, and no expert forecast.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Around 2026-09-01: Netflix will publish its weekly Top 10 for Aug 24-30. Large Netflix numbers could bring news coverage and some extra YouTube traffic. [Netflix Top 10 schedule, general practice]
- Rockstar may release follow-up marketing (screenshots, newswire posts) that sends traffic back to the video. Nothing specific is scheduled as far as I found.
- The 168-hour window closes around 2026-09-04 01:00-03:00 UTC.
- Possible YouTube view-count audits or freezes could move the final number. These are common in the first days after upload, but I found no reporting of one for this video.
